title: Connecting to the Supabase database from Vercel or GitHub Actions fails with ENETUNREACH
symptoms: could not translate host name db.PROJECT_REF.supabase.co to address
Works from a laptop but fails in serverless or CI
cause: The direct host db.PROJECT_REF.supabase.co resolves only to IPv6 since January 29, 2024, and several hosts including Vercel, GitHub Actions, Render, and Retool cannot reach IPv6. The Supavisor pooler still answers on IPv4.
fix: Use the pooler connection string (transaction mode on port 6543 for serverless, session mode on 5432 for long-lived servers), or buy the dedicated IPv4 add-on on Pro and above.
apply:
# serverless (transaction mode)
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres.PROJECT_REF:PASSWORD@aws-0-REGION.pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres
# check from the deploy host (Linux): no output means no IPv6 route to the direct host
ip -6 route show default
affected: Hosted Supabase projects since 2024-01-29, when db.PROJECT_REF.supabase.co began resolving to IPv6 only; IPv4-only networks
